summary: Highlander Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release that reports results of a geophysical study at its Corani Silver Project. The release describes induced polarization-resistivity and airborne magnetic surveys, identification of exploration targets, and mentions an unaudited cash balance of ~US$100M and no debt. There are no transaction terms, no change of control, no acquisition or divestiture, no activist campaign, no strategic review, no tender or going-private proposal. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special-situation event.
